headline: Türkiye Anticipates Exceeding $65 Billion in Tourism Revenue
summary: Türkiye expects to surpass $65 billion in tourism revenue by the end of the year, according to Culture and Tourism Minister Mehmet Nuri Ersoy.
why: Tourism is a major component of Türkiye's service exports and foreign exchange earnings, significantly impacting the country's current account balance and broader economic growth.
